chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 529 – Ji Ning's Divine Mecha Duel Against the Seamless Gate
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning battles Heavenly God Puppets and a White-Faced Flood Dragon in a clash of war gods. The Seamless Gate plans a tactical retreat, but their commander has one last test.
og_title: Desolate Era: The War of the Divine Mecha Begins!
og_description: Ji Ning unleashes a brutal knee strike to kill a White-Faced Flood Dragon, shocking both armies. The Seamless Gate pulls back, but their strongest commander has a final, earth-shattering clash in store.
twitter_title: The Xingtian God vs. The White-Faced Flood Dragon!
twitter_description: Ji Ning’s unorthodox combat style turns the tide in this war of divine giants. But the Seamless Gate’s commander has one last devastating test.

lore_anchors.definition: A massive war formation requiring many Immortals as a foundation, manifesting a giant, divine-spirit-like combat body. It is named after the mythical Chinese giant Xingtian.
A magic construct or golem used as a war machine. They are exceptionally tough in defense, comparable to Pure Yang treasures, but weaker in offense.
A type of powerful dragon-like war beast or formation manifestation used by the Seamless Gate, often commanded by high-level cultivators.
The highest grade of manufactured magic treasure in this realm of the story. ‘Breaker of All Obstacles’ is a weapon of this tier.
The primary antagonistic faction in this arc, a rival power bloc attempting to conquer the Grand Xia world and the wider Three Realms.
The Fiendgod Body Refining equivalent of a Celestial Immortal; a cultivator who has successfully transcended the Heavenly Tribulation and achieved an immortal divine body.
A Ki Refiner who has reached a level of mastery beyond a Celestial Immortal, often having grasped a complete Grand Dao.
